title: Impacts of coal smoke on infant mortality: Evidence from industrializing Japan
title_zh: 煤烟对婴儿死亡率的影响：来自日本工业化时期的证据
title_primary: 煤烟对婴儿死亡率的影响：来自日本工业化时期的证据
title_secondary: Impacts of coal smoke on infant mortality: Evidence from industrializing Japan
authors: Tatsuki Inoue
official: 官方在线 2026-09-09 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study investigates the health consequences of coal smoke during Japan's early industrialization. Using fixed‐effects models and a prefecture‐level panel dataset on actual coal consumption and infant mortality from 1899 to 1910, this study finds that higher coal consumption was positively associated with infant mortality. The baseline estimate suggests that a one‐standard‐deviation increase in the log of coal consumption was associated with approximately 2.1 additional infant deaths per 1000 live births, and that the growth in coal use was associated with an increase in infant mortality equivalent to approximately 11.8 per cent of the overall rise in infant mortality during the sample period. Further estimates using infant deaths by age interval show that this association was weak during the neonatal period but became more pronounced during the post‐neonatal period, particularly from 1 month to under 6 months after birth. These findings suggest that coal‐based industrialization carried health costs in a non‐Western industrializing economy and that the timing of pollution‐related infant mortality differed from that observed in modern contexts.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了日本早期工业化时期煤炭烟雾对健康的影响。利用固定效应模型及1899年至1910年间县级实际煤炭消费量与婴儿死亡率的面板数据，研究发现煤炭消费量的增加与婴儿死亡率呈正相关。基准估计表明，煤炭消费量对数值每增加一个标准差，与每千名活产婴儿中约增加2.1例死亡相关，且煤炭使用的增长与样本期间婴儿死亡率总体上升中约11.8%的增幅相关联。进一步按婴儿死亡年龄区间进行的估计显示，这一关联在新生儿期较弱，而在新生儿后期，尤其是出生后1个月至6个月期间，表现得更为显著。这些发现表明，在非西方工业化经济体中，以煤炭为基础的工业化带来了健康成本，且污染相关婴儿死亡的时间分布与现代情境下观察到的有所不同。

title: AI in a fragmenting world: Why ‘connector’ economies can still gain
title_zh: 碎片化世界中的AI：为何“连接型”经济体仍能获益
title_primary: 碎片化世界中的AI：为何“连接型”经济体仍能获益
title_secondary: AI in a fragmenting world: Why ‘connector’ economies can still gain
authors: Barry Eichengreen, Jingyuan Cui, Asmaa El-Ganainy, Yevgeniya Korniyenko, Elyad Shojaei, Li Zeng, Shihangyin Zhang
official: 官方在线 2026-09-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Artificial intelligence is advancing at the same time as the global economy is becoming more fragmented. AI innovation is concentrated in a small number of economies, while the gains from AI depend on technologies, intermediate inputs, data, investment, and know-how moving across borders. This column shows that fragmentation can therefore shape not only the size of the global gains from AI, but also who receives them. For economies not at the technological frontier, preserving diversified links may be a valuable form of economic optionality.
abstract_zh: 人工智能的发展与全球经济日益碎片化同步推进。人工智能创新集中于少数经济体，而其收益则依赖于技术、中间投入、数据、投资和专业知识在跨国界的流动。本专栏指出，碎片化因此不仅影响人工智能全球收益的规模，也决定其分配格局。对于处于技术前沿之外的经济体而言，保持多元化的联系可能是一种宝贵的经济选择权。

title: Voice at Work
title_zh: 工作中的话语权
title_primary: 工作中的话语权
title_secondary: Voice at Work
authors: Jarkko Harju, Simon Jäger, Benjamin Schoefer
official: 官方在线 2021-03-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We estimate the effects of worker voice on productivity, job quality, and separations. We study the 1991 introduction of a right to worker representation on boards or advisory councils in Finnish firms, designed primarily to facilitate workforce-management communication. The reform only affected firms with at least 150 employees, permitting a difference-in-differences design to analyze its causal effects. Consistent with information sharing theories, worker voice slightly raised labor productivity, firm survival, and capital intensity. In contrast to the exit-voice theory, we find no effects on voluntary job separations, and at most small positive effects on other measures of job quality (job security, health, subjective job quality, and wages). A 2008 introduction of shop-floor representation had similarly limited effects.
abstract_zh: 我们估算了员工话语权对生产率、工作质量及离职率的影响。我们研究了1991年芬兰企业引入的关于董事会或咨询委员会中员工代表权的规定，该规定主要旨在促进管理层与员工之间的沟通。这项改革仅影响员工人数至少为150人的企业，从而允许采用双重差分设计来分析其因果效应。与信息共享理论一致，员工话语权略微提高了劳动生产率、企业生存率和资本密集度。与退出-话语权理论相反，我们发现员工话语权对自愿离职没有影响，并且对其他工作质量指标（如工作保障、健康状况、主观工作质量和工资）最多只有微小的正面影响。2008年引入的车间代表制度的影响同样有限。

title: Trade Policy Uncertainty and Innovation: Evidence from China
title_zh: 贸易政策不确定性与创新：来自中国的证据
title_primary: 贸易政策不确定性与创新：来自中国的证据
title_secondary: Trade Policy Uncertainty and Innovation: Evidence from China
authors: Federica Coelli
official: 官方在线 2025-06-25 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper studies the effect of resolving trade policy uncertainty on investment in innovation in China during 1990-2007. It exploits exogenous and heterogeneous exposure to tariff uncertainty resolution arising from a major change in US trade policy, which eliminated the possibility of tariff increases on Chinese imported goods, and detailed data on innovation from all sectors and countries in a triple difference-in-differences. Eliminating tariff uncertainty has an economically and statistically significant effect on innovation, and this effect represents actual innovation, rather than just more patent filings. Next, the paper studies the mechanisms that led to this positive innovation response and shows i. that the timing is heterogeneous: high-quality and high opportunity cost innovations respond more slowly and gradually, while lower-quality innovations react quickly; ii. that the increase in innovation reflects a response on three margins: the introduction of patents in new technologies, patents with increased technological scope, and patents in a firm’s pre-period technology portfolio; iii. that relatively more exposed sectors exhibit a larger increase in the number of firms patenting for the first time; iv. that the increase in innovation is at least in part driven by exports to the US.

title: Characterizing the Conditional Pricing Kernel: A New Approach
title_zh: 刻画条件定价核：一种新方法
title_primary: 刻画条件定价核：一种新方法
title_secondary: Characterizing the Conditional Pricing Kernel: A New Approach
authors: Hyung Joo Kim
official: 聚合元数据日期 2023-01-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: I propose a novel method to reliably estimate the conditional pricing kernel by incorporating conditioning variables. The VIX and the term spread are most informative variables for identifying state prices. The conditional kernel estimate exhibits significant time variation: the more favorable market expectations, the higher state prices in negative return states. During bad times, the equity premium implied by the conditional kernel is fully attributable to compensation for left-tail scenarios, in contrast to findings from the unconditional kernel. Lastly, the conditional kernel estimate yields superior out-of-sample option pricing performance compared to the unconditional kernel estimate.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的方法，通过纳入条件变量来可靠估计条件定价核。VIX和期限利差是识别状态价格最具信息量的变量。条件核估计显示出显著的时间变化性：市场预期越乐观，负收益状态下的状态价格越高。在不利时期，条件核隐含的股权溢价完全归因于左尾情景的补偿，这与无条件核的发现形成对比。最后，与无条件核估计相比，条件核估计在样本外期权定价表现上更为优越。

title: Does Increasing Financial Access to Contraception in the U.S. Reduce Unintended Pregnancies? Evidence from the M-CARES Randomized Controlled Trial at Two Years
title_zh: 美国扩大避孕药具经济可及性能否减少意外怀孕？来自M-CARES随机对照试验两年期的证据
title_primary: 美国扩大避孕药具经济可及性能否减少意外怀孕？来自M-CARES随机对照试验两年期的证据
title_secondary: Does Increasing Financial Access to Contraception in the U.S. Reduce Unintended Pregnancies? Evidence from the M-CARES Randomized Controlled Trial at Two Years
authors: Bailey, Martha J., Brito, Emilia, Gorgulu, Deniz, Figone, Kelsey, Lang, Vanessa Wanner 等
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review: Insights · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: We use a randomized controlled trial to examine how out-of-pocket costs affect contraceptive method choice, pregnancy, abortion, and childbirth among uninsured U.S. women. The study recruited women seeking care through Title X—a national family planning program subsidizing reproductive health services for low-income Americans—and randomized vouchers, making the full spectrum of contraception highly discounted or free. We find that subsidizing contraception has large and persistent effects on the choice of contraceptive method, resulting in significantly fewer pregnancies and abortions at 26 months. The effects on births are inconclusive.
abstract_zh: 我们采用随机对照试验，考察自付费用如何影响美国无保险女性的避孕方法选择、怀孕、堕胎及分娩。研究招募了通过Title X——一项为低收入美国人提供生殖健康服务补贴的国家计划生育项目——寻求护理的女性，并随机分配代金券，使全面避孕措施大幅折扣或免费。我们发现，补贴避孕对避孕方法的选择产生了显著且持久的影响，在26个月时导致怀孕和堕胎数量显著减少。对分娩的影响则尚无定论。

title: Proportional representation primer
title_zh: 比例代表制入门
title_primary: 比例代表制入门
title_secondary: Proportional representation primer
authors: Marek M. Kaminski
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-30 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This primer provides a systematic introduction to proportional representation (PR) electoral systems for scholars and students unfamiliar with their mechanics and political consequences. PR is now used for legislative elections in approximately 118 countries, making it the world’s most common family of electoral systems. However, its formal structure and political effects are often poorly understood outside specialist communities. The primer covers the main families of apportionment algorithms (quota, divisor, and ranked-choice methods), the principal types of PR electoral systems (list PR, STV, mixed, and semi-proportional), and their key structural components, including district magnitude, thresholds, measures of disproportionality, volatility, and the effective number of parties. It surveys major empirical regularities, including Duverger’s Law, the impact of district magnitude on party fragmentation, women’s and minority representation, voter turnout, and coalition formation, before turning to paradoxes and problems, including apportionment paradoxes and the Balinski–Young impossibility theorem, STV Non-Monotonicity and the No-Show paradox, spoilers and ballot-position primacy effects in list PR, and overhang seats and decoy parties in mixed compensatory systems. The primer concludes that every apportionment method is formally flawed, that institutional parameters interact with strategic behavior in ways that frequently produce unexpected outcomes, and that the empirical regularities anchoring the field rest on identification strategies that are vulnerable to the endogeneity of electoral institutions. A Glossary of key concepts is included as an Appendix.
abstract_zh: 本导论为不熟悉比例代表制（PR）运作机制及其政治后果的学者与学生提供了系统性入门介绍。目前约有118个国家在立法选举中采用比例代表制，使其成为全球最普遍的选举制度家族。然而，其正式结构及政治影响在专业领域之外常被误解。本文涵盖席位分配算法的主要类别（配额法、除数法与排序选择法）、比例代表制的主要类型（名单比例代表制、单一可转移投票制、混合制与半比例代表制）及其关键结构性要素，包括选区规模、门槛、比例性失衡指标、波动性及有效政党数。在探讨悖论与问题前，本文梳理了主要经验规律，包括迪韦尔热定律、选区规模对政党碎片化的影响、女性与少数群体代表性、选民投票率及联盟形成机制；随后转向分配悖论与巴林斯基-杨不可能定理、单一可转移投票制的非单调性与缺席悖论、名单比例代表制中的搅局者与选票位置优先效应，以及混合补偿制中的超额席位与掩护政党。本文结论指出：每种分配方法均存在形式缺陷；制度参数与策略行为互动常产生非预期结果；支撑该领域的经验规律所依赖的识别策略易受选举制度内生性问题影响。附录包含关键概念词汇表。

title: Navigating the "Problem from Hell": A Guide to Climate Damages
title_zh: 驾驭“地狱难题”：气候损害指南
title_primary: 驾驭“地狱难题”：气候损害指南
title_secondary: Navigating the "Problem from Hell": A Guide to Climate Damages
authors: Lemoine, Derek, Hausman, Catherine, Shrader, Jeffrey G.
official: 来源期次 Journal of Economic Literature · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: Multiple lines of research aim to quantify the economic impacts of climate change. We show that the effects of climate change on economic activity depend on how climate change alters weather across time and space. Changes in contemporary weather have direct effects on output; changes in past weather and in expectations of future weather induce adaptation; and changes in weather elsewhere around the globe introduce a general equilibrium effect. Using this framework, we argue that estimation of climate impacts faces a trilemma. A methodology can have at most two of: (i) robustness to a particular economic model’s structure, (ii) interpretation as effects of persistent, widespread, anticipated climate change, and (iii) quasi-experimental identification. We summarize the literature on climate damages in light of the trilemma. A solid body of knowledge has developed around direct effects, and recent work has made substantial progress towards understanding adaptation and spatial spillovers.
abstract_zh: 多项研究旨在量化气候变化的经济影响。我们表明，气候变化对经济活动的影响取决于气候变化如何改变不同时间和空间上的天气状况。当代天气的变化对产出产生直接影响；过去天气的变化以及对未来天气的预期会引发适应性调整；而全球其他地区天气的变化则引入了一般均衡效应。基于这一框架，我们认为气候影响的估计面临一个三难困境。一种方法论最多只能满足以下三个条件中的两个：（i）对特定经济模型结构的稳健性，（ii）能够解释为持续性、广泛性、可预期的气候变化的影响，以及（iii）准实验识别。我们根据这一三难困境对气候损害相关文献进行了总结。围绕直接影响已形成了较为扎实的知识体系，而近期研究在理解适应性调整和空间溢出效应方面取得了实质性进展。

title: Unconventional policy and idiosyncratic risk
title_zh: 非常规政策与特质风险
title_primary: 非常规政策与特质风险
title_secondary: Unconventional policy and idiosyncratic risk
authors: Salvatore Nisticò, Marialaura Seccareccia
official: 官方在线 2026-07-24 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Within a New Keynesian model with heterogeneous households and credit frictions, we show that idiosyncratic uncertainty gives rise to an additional transmission channel that amplifies the effects of balance-sheet policies through consumption risk, making them a key tool for anchoring private-sector expectations. We further show that the optimal monetary policy features a clear division of labor between conventional and unconventional tools: balance-sheet policy should target cross-sectional welfare objectives, absorbing fluctuations in variables with distributional relevance such as private debt, whereas conventional interest-rate policy stabilizes aggregate targets and responds to aggregate shocks, as in the representative-agent benchmark. Thus, the optimal response to a debt-deleveraging crisis is unconventional: it entails a shorter, rather than longer, duration of zero-interest-rate policies relative to conventional inflation targeting, and does not require front-loaded inflation at the effective lower bound.
abstract_zh: 在包含异质性家庭与信贷摩擦的新凯恩斯模型中，我们证明特质性不确定性通过消费风险催生了一个额外的传导渠道，该渠道放大了资产负债表政策的效应，使其成为锚定私人部门预期的关键工具。我们进一步证明，最优货币政策在传统工具与非传统工具之间呈现出明确的分工：资产负债表政策应瞄准横截面福利目标，吸收具有分配相关性的变量（如私人债务）的波动，而传统利率政策则稳定总量目标并对总量冲击作出反应，这与代表性代理人基准情形一致。因此，对债务去杠杆危机的最优应对是非传统的：相对于传统通胀目标制，它意味着更短而非更长的零利率政策持续时间，并且不需要在有效下限处进行前置通胀。

title: How does ICT relate to school efficiency in Europe? Evidence from OECD PISA 2022
title_zh: ICT如何影响欧洲学校效率？基于OECD PISA 2022的证据
title_primary: ICT如何影响欧洲学校效率？基于OECD PISA 2022的证据
title_secondary: How does ICT relate to school efficiency in Europe? Evidence from OECD PISA 2022
authors: Mara Soncin, Tommaso Agasisti
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-22 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper investigates how Information and Communication Technologies (ICT) relate to school efficiency, drawing on data from the OECD PISA 2022 survey for 5,360 schools across 21 EU countries. We estimate school-level efficiency scores using a robust nonparametric order-m model under a meta-frontier framework, distinguishing between local (within-country) and global (cross-country) benchmarks. We also run a robust conditional efficiency model in which exogenous variables are indicators of ICT availability and use, showing how ICT is associated with an increase in average efficiency. We also employ a multilevel random forest model to explore which ICT-related variables best explain efficiency scores. Findings highlight that cognitively engaging digital activities such as student-led research, data analysis, and the use of digital learning games are positively associated with efficiency, especially when used in moderation (i.e. avoiding its excessive use).
abstract_zh: 本文利用OECD PISA 2022调查中21个欧盟国家5360所学校的数据，探究信息通信技术（ICT）与学校效率之间的关系。我们采用元前沿框架下的稳健非参数order-m模型估算学校层面的效率得分，区分了本地（国家内部）与全球（跨国）基准。同时，我们运行了稳健的条件效率模型，将ICT可用性与使用指标作为外生变量，揭示ICT如何与平均效率提升相关联。此外，我们运用多层随机森林模型，探索哪些ICT相关变量最能解释效率得分差异。研究结果表明：以学生主导研究、数据分析及数字学习游戏为代表的认知参与型数字活动与效率呈正相关，尤其在适度使用（即避免过度使用）时效果更为显著。

title: Granular Sentiments
title_zh: 颗粒化情绪
title_primary: 颗粒化情绪
title_secondary: Granular Sentiments
authors: Jamilov, Rustam, Kohlhas, Alexandre, Talavera, Oleksandr, Zhang, Mao
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We propose an empirically consistent theory of business cycles driven by fluctuations in the sentiment of a small number of firms. Using computational linguistics and analyst forecasts, we find that around 50 firms can account for over 60% of the variation in U.S. sentiment and macroeconomic outcomes. Our â€ Granular Sentiment Indexâ€ , which measures the sentiment of these firms, is dominated by downstream firms that are close to the final consumer. Incorporating endogenous attention choice into a general equilibrium model with heterogeneous firms, we show that this heterogeneity arises because downstream firms act as natural "information agglomeratorsâ€ . A calibrated version of the model shows that sentiment shocks to the 20% most downstream firms explain 70% of sentiment-driven (and 20% of aggregate) fluctuations.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种经验上一致的经济周期理论，该理论由少数企业情绪的波动驱动。利用计算语言学和分析师预测，我们发现约50家企业可以解释美国情绪和宏观经济结果超过60%的变动。我们构建的“颗粒情绪指数”衡量这些企业的情绪，其中占主导地位的是靠近最终消费者的下游企业。通过将内生注意力选择纳入一个包含异质性企业的一般均衡模型，我们表明这种异质性源于下游企业作为天然的“信息聚合体”。模型的校准版本显示，对最下游20%企业的情绪冲击解释了70%的情绪驱动波动（以及20%的总波动）。

title: Assessing the impact of land consolidation on agricultural transport-related Co₂ emissions
title_zh: 评估土地整理对农业运输相关二氧化碳排放的影响
title_primary: 评估土地整理对农业运输相关二氧化碳排放的影响
title_secondary: Assessing the impact of land consolidation on agricultural transport-related Co₂ emissions
authors: Ela Ertunç, Halime Nur Kök
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-18 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Carbon emissions are one of the most important drivers of climate change, threatening global sustainability goals. The agricultural sector, which is one of the important sources of greenhouse gas emissions (GHG), deepens this problem with increased fuel consumption and CO₂ emissions due to land fragmentation. When fragmented lands are transformed into large and holistic agricultural areas thanks to land consolidation (LC), tractor operations can be carried out more regularly and this can reduce fuel consumption. This study examines the impacts on transport-related CO₂ emissions and fuel consumption in three different land consolidation areas (Akçaşar, Borukuyu and Yenikuyu). Transportation distances before and after land consolidation were analysed and linked to tractor fuel consumption; transport-related CO₂ emissions were estimated based on these data. In the calculations, the Tier 1 method was applied based on the guide published by the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC). The study also tested whether the differences in distance achieved in the before and after LC periods were statistically significant. The results show that the number of parcels decreased and transportation distances were significantly reduced after land consolidation. Accordingly, fuel consumption and transport-related CO₂ emissions decreased by 32% in Akçaşar, 25% in Borukuyu, and 30% in Yenikuyu, respectively. Paired sample t-test and Wilcoxon analyses confirmed that these differences were statistically significant (p < 0.001), while Cohen’s d values indicated a moderate effect size. These findings demonstrate that land consolidation can significantly reduce transport-related emissions by improving the efficiency of agricultural transportation processes and can contribute to sustainable agriculture and climate change adaptation policies.
abstract_zh: 碳排放是气候变化最重要的驱动因素之一，威胁着全球可持续发展目标。农业部门作为温室气体排放的重要来源之一，因土地细碎化导致的燃料消耗增加和二氧化碳排放，进一步加剧了这一问题。当通过土地整理将细碎地块转变为大型整体农业区域时，拖拉机作业可以更加规律地进行，从而可能减少燃料消耗。本研究考察了三个不同土地整理区域（Akçaşar、Borukuyu和Yenikuyu）对运输相关二氧化碳排放和燃料消耗的影响。分析了土地整理前后的运输距离，并将其与拖拉机燃料消耗相关联；基于这些数据估算了运输相关的二氧化碳排放。在计算中，采用了基于政府间气候变化专门委员会（IPCC）发布指南的Tier 1方法。研究还检验了土地整理前后距离差异是否具有统计学显著性。结果表明，土地整理后地块数量减少，运输距离显著缩短。相应地，Akçaşar的燃料消耗和运输相关二氧化碳排放减少了32%，Borukuyu减少了25%，Yenikuyu减少了30%。配对样本t检验和Wilcoxon分析证实这些差异具有统计学显著性（p < 0.001），而Cohen's d值表明效应量适中。这些发现表明，土地整理可以通过提高农业运输过程的效率显著减少运输相关排放，并有助于可持续农业和气候变化适应政策。

abstract: I construct a novel dataset comprising over 100,000 loan observations from U.S. firms and estimate that renegotiating existing loans —rather than originating new loans —significantly contributes to the corporate investment response to monetary policy shocks, accounting for half of the aggregate effect. abstract: This is the first study to estimate the impact of sports gambling legalization on food sufficiency using the staggered implementation of state laws between 2021-2023. By analyzing Google searches for online sportsbooks and legal wagers, we show that interest in sports gambling increases sharply following legalization. Applying an imputation-based difference-in-differences design to biweekly Household Pulse Survey (HPS) data, we find that legalized sports gambling reduces household food sufficiency by 2.1 percent among working-age adults without a college degree, which translates to a 10.5 percent decline among active bettors. This effect is cyclical, persisting for three-to-five months during NFL seasons. Additionally, the declines in food sufficiency are larger among households with adults aged 25-44 and racial/ethnic minorities. Using additional data from the HPS, Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System and Current Population Survey, our exploration of mechanisms suggests that the negative effects on food sufficiency operate through financial distress rather than changes in mental health or labor supply. A back-of-the-envelope calculation indicates that legalization of sports gambling in nine states resulted in an additional 284,000 food-insufficient households and $130.2 million in excess healthcare expenditures annually.
abstract_zh: 本研究首次利用2021至2023年间各州法律分阶段实施的情况，评估体育博彩合法化对食物充足性的影响。通过分析在线体育博彩平台的谷歌搜索量及合法投注数据，我们发现合法化后公众对体育博彩的兴趣急剧上升。采用基于插补的双重差分法对双周家庭脉搏调查数据进行分析，结果显示：体育博彩合法化使未获得大学学位的劳动年龄人口家庭食物充足性下降2.1%，相当于活跃投注者群体中10.5%的降幅。该效应呈现周期性特征，在NFL赛季期间持续三至五个月。此外，在25-44岁成年人家庭及少数族裔群体中，食物充足性下降幅度更为显著。结合家庭脉搏调查、行为风险因素监测系统及当前人口调查的补充数据，机制分析表明：食物充足性受损主要通过财务困境渠道传导，而非心理健康或劳动供给变化所致。粗略估算显示，九个州的体育博彩合法化每年导致新增28.4万个食物不足家庭，并产生1.302亿美元的额外医疗支出。

title: Don’t Give Up on Lab Experiments: Why the Field Still Needs the Lab
title_zh: 不要放弃实验室实验：为何田野研究仍需实验室
title_primary: 不要放弃实验室实验：为何田野研究仍需实验室
title_secondary: Don’t Give Up on Lab Experiments: Why the Field Still Needs the Lab
authors: John A. List
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Recent enthusiasm for field experiments, and especially for natural field experiments (NFEs), in which subjects go about their daily activities unaware that any study is taking place, has sometimes been read as a verdict against the laboratory. I argue that such a verdict is wrong. Through the lens of a simple rational-choice model, I show that the four standard experimental designs (laboratory, artefactual field experiment (AFE), framed field experiment (FFE), and NFE) are comparative-static restrictions of one maximization problem, each identifying a parameter the others cannot. The model reveals that each design type has distinctive strengths and weaknesses across various dimensions of knowledge creation, including the enforcement of the conditions for causal identification, the faithfulness of the experimental environment to the theory being tested, the identification of economic primitives via theoretical structure, and the ethics of studying human subjects. On each of the dimensions, the four design types are complements rather than rivals. Nowhere is this complementarity more evident than between the two extremes. The lab enforces the conditions for causal identification that the NFE must inherit from the market; the NFE recovers the parameter that governs behaviour in the wild, free of the selection, scrutiny, and environmental distortions the lab cannot escape. A research programme using all four designs together demonstrates something no single design can produce. The framework further accommodates the recent rise of online and survey experiments as natural extensions. Our discipline’s recent drift away from laboratory evidence is leaving an important structural gap that natural field experiments, however well conceived, cannot fill.
abstract_zh: 近年来对实地实验，尤其是自然实地实验（NFEs）的热衷——受试者在日常活动中完全不知情自己正参与研究——有时被解读为对实验室实验的否定。本文认为这种否定是错误的。通过一个简单理性选择模型的视角，我证明四种标准实验设计（实验室实验、人工实地实验（AFE）、框架实地实验（FFE）和自然实地实验（NFE））是同一最大化问题的比较静态约束，每种设计都能识别其他设计无法识别的参数。该模型揭示，在知识创造的多个维度上，每种设计类型都具有独特的优势与劣势，包括因果识别条件的执行、实验环境与被检验理论的一致性、通过理论结构识别经济基本要素，以及研究人类受试者的伦理问题。在这每个维度上，四种设计类型是互补而非竞争关系。这种互补性在实验室与自然实地实验这两个极端之间表现得最为显著：实验室强制执行因果识别条件，而自然实地实验必须从市场中继承这些条件；自然实地实验则能恢复支配真实世界行为的参数，不受实验室无法避免的选择、审视和环境扭曲的影响。采用全部四种设计的研究计划能够展现单一设计无法实现的结果。该框架还进一步将近年来兴起的在线实验和调查实验视为自然延伸。我们学科近期对实验室证据的疏离正在留下重要的结构性空白，而自然实地实验无论设计得多么精妙，都无法填补这一空白。

abstract: This paper study the effects of investment delay on the dynamics of economic growth. To analyse the solutions of the model we use one of the special functions, the Lambert W function. The analytical and numerical methods are used to study the local stability of steady solution. title_zh: 高维均值向量的无分布收缩

official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We introduce shrinkage estimators of the sample mean vector in high dimension. Our estimators share desirable properties relative to existing methods: they are distribution-free, consider bona-fide target estimators, and use simple estimators of the shrinkage intensities independent of the precision matrix which are L2 consistent in high dimension. Unlike existing estimators that impose that the whitened data be an i.i.d. matrix, we only impose i.i.d. across sample observations. We require uniform boundedness of the first four moments, and the high-dimensional asymptotics are in a general Kolmogorov setting where N/T=O(1) as T→∞, with N the mean-vector dimension and T the sample size. We consider as a target estimator either zero or the grand mean. Simulations show that our shrinkage estimators are competitive with a range of benchmark estimators, both when the theoretical assumptions are satisfied and violated. Finally, we apply our estimators to constructing mean-variance portfolios of a large number of stocks, and find that they deliver robust out-of-sample Sharpe ratios.

abstract: Evidence on the long-run mental health effects of disasters remains limited. This study estimates the causal effects of exposure to extreme weather events (EWEs) on mental health treatment among working-age adults in New Zealand. Unlike much of the existing literature, which focuses on single disasters, short-term outcomes, and self-reported distress, we use longitudinal administrative population data within a staggered difference-in-differences framework to exploit variation in the timing and frequency of exposure across individuals and regions. The analysis distinguishes between moderate and severe mental health conditions and estimates effects on both the probability of receiving treatment and the number of treatment days. We find no statistically significant population-level effects of EWE exposure on treatment of either moderate or severe mental illness. However, subgroup analyses indicate some heterogeneity, particularly among individuals in the lowest income tercile and younger adults for moderate outcomes. Overall, the findings suggest that increases in psychological distress documented in the broader disaster literature do not necessarily translate into broad-based or sustained changes in formal mental health treatment. The study provides new evidence on how climate-related shocks shape realised mental healthcare utilisation over time.
abstract_zh: 关于灾害对心理健康长期影响的证据仍然有限。本研究利用新西兰劳动年龄人口数据，估计极端天气事件暴露对心理健康治疗的因果效应。与现有文献多聚焦单一灾害、短期结果及自我报告的心理困扰不同，我们采用交错双重差分框架下的纵向行政人口数据，利用个体与地区间暴露时间及频率的差异进行分析。研究区分了中度与重度心理健康状况，并评估了极端天气事件对接受治疗概率及治疗天数的影响。结果显示，极端天气事件暴露对中度或重度精神疾病治疗均未产生统计上显著的人口层面效应。然而，亚组分析表明存在一定异质性，尤其在收入最低三分位群体及年轻成年人中，中度心理健康结果呈现差异。总体而言，研究提示灾害文献中记录的心理困扰增加未必转化为广泛或持续的正式心理健康治疗变化。本研究为气候相关冲击如何随时间影响实际心理健康服务利用提供了新证据。

abstract: This study examines the causal impact of tax education on property tax compliance in Benin. Utilizing a randomized controlled trial, two distinct interventions—deterrence and persuasion—were implemented to evaluate their effectiveness. The findings indicate that both approaches significantly and positively influence taxpayer behavior compared to those who received no intervention. However, the deterrence treatment demonstrates a stronger causal effect than the persuasion approach. A formal Clogg-Paternoster test confirms that the difference between the two treatments is not statistically significant at conventional levels. Therefore, assignments were made with the same intensity. Moreover, taxpayers exposed to deterrence measures paid, on average, 30.19% more than those in the control group, representing an additional 9,588 XOF. A cost-effectiveness analysis suggests that the deterrence-based intervention yields higher returns per unit of implementation cost compared to the persuasion approach.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了税收教育对贝宁房产税遵从度的因果影响。通过随机对照试验，实施了两项不同的干预措施——威慑与劝导——以评估其有效性。结果表明，与未接受任何干预的对照组相比，这两种方法均显著且积极地影响了纳税人的行为。然而，威慑处理显示出比劝导方法更强的因果效应。正式的Clogg-Paternoster检验确认，在常规显著性水平下，两种处理之间的差异在统计上并不显著。因此，任务分配以相同强度进行。此外，接触威慑措施的纳税人平均比对照组多支付30.19%，相当于额外缴纳9，588西非法郎。成本效益分析表明，基于威慑的干预措施每单位实施成本产生的回报高于劝导方法。

abstract: The cultivation of economic resilience in poverty-stricken areas is often constrained by capital shortage and development path locking. While existing studies primarily examine resilience through industrial composition and upgrading, the role of industrial land use structure as a spatially embedded and institutionally mediated dimension of economic organization remains underexplored. Based on data from 756 Chinese poverty-stricken counties (2010–2020), this study employs the shift-share model and XGBoost-SHAP method to examine the nonlinear and heterogeneous relationships between structural adjustment of industrial land use and economic resilience. The adopted methodological framework further uncovers threshold effects and nonlinear patterns that are difficult to detect using linear approaches. The results exhibit pronounced heterogeneity across land use types: a high concentration of resource-intensive industrial land is associated with lower economic resilience, reflecting potential technology lock-in; adjustments in capital-intensive industrial land exhibit an inverted U-shaped relationship with resilience; and higher shares of labor- and technology-intensive industrial land are consistently associated with stronger resilience, likely through employment expansion and knowledge spillovers. These findings demonstrate that industrial land use structure provides a complementary analytical lens by linking land allocation, factor mobility, and development path dependence. By highlighting the differentiated and policy-conditioned associations between industrial land use structure and economic resilience, this study offers insights into resilience-building strategies for poverty-stricken regions.
abstract_zh: 贫困地区经济韧性的培育往往受制于资本短缺与发展路径锁定。现有研究主要从产业构成与升级视角考察经济韧性，而工业用地结构作为经济组织在空间嵌入与制度中介维度上的重要体现，其作用尚未得到充分探讨。基于2010—2020年中国756个贫困县的数据，本研究采用偏离-份额模型与XGBoost-SHAP方法，考察工业用地结构调整与经济韧性之间的非线性及异质性关系。所采用的方法框架进一步揭示了线性方法难以识别的门槛效应与非线性模式。研究结果在用地类型间呈现出显著异质性：资源密集型工业用地的高集中度与较低的经济韧性相关联，反映出潜在的技术锁定效应；资本密集型工业用地的调整与经济韧性呈倒U型关系；劳动密集型与技术密集型工业用地占比的上升则始终与更强的经济韧性相关，其作用机制可能源于就业扩张与知识溢出。上述发现表明，工业用地结构通过联结土地配置、要素流动与发展路径依赖，为经济韧性研究提供了互补性的分析视角。通过揭示工业用地结构与经济韧性之间差异化且受政策条件调节的关联，本研究为贫困地区韧性建设策略提供了启示。

title: A hidden health impact of heat: exacerbated anemia in India
title_zh: 热浪的隐性健康影响：印度贫血症的加剧
title_primary: 热浪的隐性健康影响：印度贫血症的加剧
title_secondary: A hidden health impact of heat: exacerbated anemia in India
authors: Claire Lepault, Philippe Quirion, Pierre Uginet
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-20 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Global warming is having increasingly negative health effects, particularly in relatively poor and hot countries such as India. These impacts are partly due to the direct effect of high temperatures on the human body, and partly due to vector-borne diseases and reduced food availability. While numerous harmful health effects of high temperatures have been established, there is very little research into their possible impact on anemia, a medical condition affecting 25% of the global population and 43 % of people in India. Using health, nutrition and climate data, we analyze the relationship between heat exposure and anemia in India over the past decade. We match blood hemoglobin measurements from nearly 265,000 children, 914,000 women and 140,000 men to two different measurements of exposure to heat, based on air temperature and wet-bulb globe temperature respectively. We find that heat exposure in the 30 days preceding blood measurement is associated with anemia in these three population groups. Moreover, the mechanisms responsible do not seem to be related to nutritional deficiencies, while direct effects and malaria could explain part of the relationship between temperature and anemia. Finally, we estimate the number of extra anemia cases induced by a + 2 ∘ C increase in air temperature, which has an associated cost of around 4.2 billion US dollars, i.e., 0.11 % of Indian GDP.
abstract_zh: 全球变暖正对健康产生日益严重的负面影响，尤其是在印度这样相对贫困且炎热的国家。这些影响部分源于高温对人体的直接作用，部分则归因于媒介传播疾病和粮食供应减少。尽管高温的诸多有害健康效应已被证实，但关于其对贫血——一种影响全球25%人口及印度43%人口的医学状况——可能产生的影响，研究却寥寥无几。利用健康、营养和气候数据，我们分析了过去十年间印度热暴露与贫血之间的关系。我们将近265,000名儿童、914,000名女性和140,000名男性的血液血红蛋白测量数据，分别与基于气温和湿球黑球温度的两种不同热暴露测量指标进行匹配。研究发现，在血液测量前30天内的热暴露与这三个人群中的贫血状况相关联。此外，其作用机制似乎与营养缺乏无关，而直接影响和疟疾可能部分解释了温度与贫血之间的关联。最后，我们估算了气温升高+2°C所导致的额外贫血病例数量，其相关成本约为42亿美元，相当于印度GDP的0.11%。

title: Labor market penalty for single mothers
title_zh: 单亲母亲的劳动力市场惩罚
title_primary: 单亲母亲的劳动力市场惩罚
title_secondary: Labor market penalty for single mothers
authors: Somdeep Chatterjee, Ralitza Dimova, Shubham Ojha
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Little is known about single mothers' labor market outcomes. On the one hand, they might not havethe typical social constraints of married women in traditional patriarchal societies, but on theother hand, they face the same constraints with respect to childcare and childbearing as othermarried mothers. While aggregate data suggests that single mothers’ participationrates are usually higher than those unmarried, we argue that in contrast tomarried women, this realized labor market equilibriummasks potential demand-side discrimination and likely reflects strong supply-side incentives.To uncover potential demand-side discrimination effects, we conduct a correspondencestudy experiment that involves applying to real jobs using fictitious resumes. Weshow that equally qualified single mothers are much less likely to receive interview callbacksthan unmarried women without children, married without children, and married mothers. Forevery interview callback a single mother has to apply to about 30 jobs, whereas an unmarriedwoman receives more than two callbacks for as many job applications.
abstract_zh: 关于单身母亲的劳动力市场结果，我们知之甚少。一方面，她们可能不像传统父权社会中的已婚女性那样受到典型的社会约束；但另一方面，她们在育儿和生育方面面临与其他已婚母亲相同的限制。尽管总体数据显示，单身母亲的劳动参与率通常高于未婚女性，但我们认为，与已婚女性相比，这一已实现的劳动力市场均衡掩盖了潜在的需求侧歧视，并可能反映了强大的供给侧激励。为了揭示潜在的需求侧歧视效应，我们进行了一项通信研究实验，使用虚构简历申请真实职位。结果显示，同等资质的单身母亲获得面试回应的可能性远低于无子女的未婚女性、无子女的已婚女性以及已婚母亲。每获得一次面试回应，单身母亲需申请约30份工作，而未婚女性在相同数量的申请中能收到超过两次回应。

title: Inflation targeting, Monetary policy, and Inequality
title_zh: 通胀目标、货币政策与不平等
title_primary: 通胀目标、货币政策与不平等
title_secondary: Inflation targeting, Monetary policy, and Inequality
authors: Georgios Chortareas, Anastasios Evgenidis, Apostolos Fasianos
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-05 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper explores whether the transmission from monetary policy to income inequality may depend on the adoption of Inflation Targeting (IT) regimes. Using an interacted panel VAR, we find that expansionary monetary policy shocks reduce income inequality in countries that have switched to IT regimes. In contrast, in non-IT regimes the same shock is associated with a short-lived increase in income inequality. A decomposition of transmission channels indicates that the employment channel is the primary equalizing mechanism under IT, as expansionary shocks generate stronger improvements in labor market conditions. The financial channel operates in the opposite direction but is quantitatively smaller. We further show that the inequality-reducing effects of monetary policy are not replicated by other institutional features often associated with credibility, such as central bank transparency or central bank independence. Our findings are robust to alternative identification schemes, broader classifications of IT regimes, controls for self-selection into IT adoption, and to conditioning on different inflation environments.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了货币政策向收入不平等的传导是否可能取决于通胀目标制（IT）制度的采纳。通过使用交互面板VAR模型，我们发现，在已转向通胀目标制的国家，扩张性货币政策冲击会降低收入不平等。相比之下，在非通胀目标制国家，同样的冲击则与收入不平等的短期加剧相关。对传导渠道的分解表明，就业渠道是通胀目标制下的主要均等化机制，因为扩张性冲击能更显著地改善劳动力市场状况。金融渠道则朝相反方向作用，但其影响在数量上较小。我们进一步证明，货币政策的降低不平等效应并不能被其他常与可信度相关的制度特征所复制，如中央银行透明度或中央银行独立性。我们的研究结果对于替代识别方案、更广泛的通胀目标制分类、对采纳通胀目标制的自选择控制以及不同通胀环境下的条件设定均保持稳健。

title: Uneven Product Diversification: Explaining the Lag of Agricultural Economies
title_zh: 产品多样化不均衡：解释农业经济体的滞后
title_primary: 产品多样化不均衡：解释农业经济体的滞后
title_secondary: Uneven Product Diversification: Explaining the Lag of Agricultural Economies
authors: Guzmán Ourens
official: 官方在线 2026-04-27 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper documents that agricultural sectors diversify less than other manufacturing activities. A simple model shows that this difference can contribute to welfare divergence in a way that is qualitatively different to what results when uneven growth happens in the intensive margin. When consumers have love of variety, they endogenously reduce their expenditure share on the sector that diversifies production the least, pushing terms of trade against the lagging economy. Empirical evidence supports these patterns in agricultural economies. Uneven product diversification plays a relevant quantitative role in explaining expenditure share shifts and terms of trade movements, which complements existing explanations.
abstract_zh: 本文记录了农业部门相对于其他制造业活动的多元化程度较低。一个简单模型表明，这种差异可能以与集约边际上不均衡增长所导致的结果在性质上不同的方式，促成福利分化。当消费者具有品种偏好时，他们会内生地减少对生产多元化程度最低部门的支出份额，从而推动贸易条件对落后经济体不利。实证证据支持了农业经济中的这些模式。产品多元化的不均衡在解释支出份额变动和贸易条件变化方面发挥着重要的定量作用，这补充了现有的解释。

title: Momentum, bubble and information transmission
title_zh: 动量、泡沫与信息传递
title_primary: 动量、泡沫与信息传递
title_secondary: Momentum, bubble and information transmission
authors: Yan Tong, Yiming Wang, Yu Yan
official: 官方在线 2025-09-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In financial markets, there are always many stories or emotions circulating slowly. Traders analyse the reasonable price of risky assets based on their own information or emotions. In order to explore the nature of financial markets caused by information transmission, we use a continuous time incomplete information dynamic random general equilibrium model to analyse the slow transmission of multiple information. A simple model was used to show the mechanism more clearly. The model effectively includes market characteristics such as momentum effect, reversal effect and bubble. According to the results of numerical simulation based on SP500, the model effectively replicates various market characteristics in SP500 market.
abstract_zh: 在金融市场中，总有许多故事或情绪缓慢流传。交易者依据自身信息或情绪分析风险资产的合理价格。为探究信息传递引发的金融市场本质，我们采用连续时间不完全信息动态随机一般均衡模型，分析多重信息的缓慢传播。通过一个简化模型更清晰地展示其机制。该模型有效涵盖了动量效应、反转效应及泡沫等市场特征。基于SP500的数值模拟结果显示，模型能有效复现SP500市场中的多种市场特性。

title: Can the digital economy promote green industrial productivity? Evidence from China
title_zh: 数字经济能否促进绿色工业生产率？来自中国的证据
title_primary: 数字经济能否促进绿色工业生产率？来自中国的证据
title_secondary: Can the digital economy promote green industrial productivity? Evidence from China
authors: Hui Wang
official: 官方在线 2025-08-08 · 来源：RSS
abstract: With the deepening of China’s industrial green transformation, traditional environmental regulation policies, while effective in promoting enterprises’ passive emission reduction behaviours, struggle to stimulate sustained green technological innovation. As a key driving force for technological transformation, the digital economy offers a new pathway for enhancing green production efficiency. This study explores how the digital economy influences China’s green industrial productivity using provincial panel data from 2011 to 2023. A super-efficiency SBM model with undesirable outputs measures green production efficiency, and a digital economy index is constructed using the entropy method. A spatial econometric model analyzes this relationship, supplemented by mediation and threshold effect models to reveal underlying mechanisms. The findings highlight three key points: (1) The digital economy significantly improves green industrial efficiency. (2) Human capital accumulation and industrial structure upgrading serve as the primary mediating pathways through which the digital economy drives green industrial production efficiency. (3) A threshold effect in human capital indicates that once it surpasses a certain level, the impact of the digital economy on green efficiency increases significantly. These results suggest that accelerating digital transformation and integrating digital technologies with industrial production are essential for enhancing green industrial efficiency and promoting sustainable development.

title: An Empirical Approximation of the Effects of Trade Sanctions with an Application to Russia
title_zh: 贸易制裁效果的实证近似：以俄罗斯为例
title_primary: 贸易制裁效果的实证近似：以俄罗斯为例
title_secondary: An Empirical Approximation of the Effects of Trade Sanctions with an Application to Russia
authors: Jean Imbs, Laurent Pauwels
official: 官方在线 2023-04-09 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We propose a data-based approximation of the effects of trade sanctions. We validate the approximation by comparing it with exact responses simulated from a canonical multi-country multi-sector model. The approximation is palatable for a broad range of elasticities of substitution, except for extremely low ones. It is based on a decomposition of high order trade according to destination or inputs markets and can readily be computed on the basis of international input-output data. As such it provides a practical shortcut to evaluating the consequences of trade sanctions without having to make difficult calibration choices. We implement our approximation to evaluate the consequences of trade sanctions between Europe and Russia. Our approximated effects are within the range of existing estimates, but they mask vast asymmetries. First, the effects of sanctions are about fifteen times larger on Russia than on Europe. Second, the effects within Europe are enormously asymmetric, with much larger consequences on ex-“satellite” countries of the Soviet Union than on large Western European economies. We then adapt our approach to show that the most affected European countries do not typically have access to substitute markets and are in fact highly dependent on Russia. We show that this extreme dependence on Russia is at least partly explained by the existence of specific energy transporting infrastructure (pipelines) that appear to constrain tightly the production of electricity in those heavily affected East European economies. These findings illustrate the practical potentiality of our approximation in a variety of different contexts.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种基于数据的贸易制裁效应近似方法。通过将其与经典多国多部门模型模拟的精确响应进行比较，验证了该近似的有效性。该近似适用于除极低替代弹性外的大多数弹性范围。其原理基于按目的地或投入市场划分的高阶贸易分解，可直接利用国际投入产出数据计算。因此，它为评估贸易制裁后果提供了一种实用捷径，无需进行复杂的校准选择。我们运用该近似方法评估了欧洲与俄罗斯之间贸易制裁的后果。近似结果与现有估计范围一致，但揭示了巨大的不对称性：首先，制裁对俄罗斯的影响约为对欧洲影响的十五倍；其次，欧洲内部的影响极不对称，对前苏联"卫星国"的影响远大于西欧主要经济体。我们进一步调整方法，发现受影响最严重的欧洲国家通常无法获得替代市场，实际上高度依赖俄罗斯。研究表明，这种对俄罗斯的极端依赖至少部分源于特定能源运输基础设施（管道）的存在——这些设施严重制约了受冲击严重的东欧经济体的电力生产。这些发现展示了该近似方法在不同情境下的实用潜力。
